biggest_catch: The bonus is variable 'up to $50' per referral with no guaranteed floor — the referred friend must complete qualifying activities (recurring direct deposits and/or 15 debit-card purchases within 90 days).
catches: The new customer earns $25 for qualifying direct deposit(s) and/or $25 for 15 debit card purchases (up to $50); the referrer earns up to $50 per new relationship.
Offer valid 12/15/2025–12/31/2026; valid for Florida residents only.
Existing customers (including those with accounts closed within 12 months) and Seacoast Bank associates are not eligible.
Bonuses are considered interest and may be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Cap: up to ten referrals ($500 value) per calendar year.

c2.evidence: Page states 'Up to $50 bonus offer available to both the current Seacoast customer who refers a new prospective customer that opens a new Seacoast checking account and the new Seacoast checking customer completes qualifying activities' — the per-referral bonus is variable with no guaranteed floor; up to ten referrals ($500 value) per calendar year.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: an existing Seacoast customer refers a prospective customer who opens a new Seacoast checking account and completes qualifying activities within 90 days (qualifying direct deposit(s) and/or 15 Seacoast debit card purchases, excluding ATM).

c4.evidence: Timing: the bonus will be credited to the eligible accounts within 95 days of account opening if the requirements have been met.
